$comment: 언어와 무관한 표시용 측정값 (예제 03 모델 기준): 증감 색, 파생 비율. @이름은 테마 색 토큰.

Sales Trend.expr: VAR _t = FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( '날짜'[월번호] ), "SalesV", [매출] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [SalesV] ) ) VAR _m0 = MINX ( _t, '날짜'[월번호] ) VAR _m1 = MAXX ( _t, '날짜'[월번호] ) VAR _span = MAX ( _m1 - _m0, 1 ) VAR _lo = MINX ( _t, [SalesV] ) VAR _hi = MAXX ( _t, [SalesV] ) VAR _rng = IF ( _hi = _lo, 1, _hi - _lo ) VAR _pts = CONCATENATEX ( _t, FORMAT ( 3 + ( '날짜'[월번호] - _m0 ) * 94 / _span, "0.0", "en-US" ) & "," & FORMAT ( 21 - ( [SalesV] - _lo ) * 18 / _rng, "0.0", "en-US" ), " ", '날짜'[월번호], ASC ) VAR _end = MAXX ( FILTER ( _t, '날짜'[월번호] = _m1 ), [SalesV] ) VAR _dot = SUBSTITUTE ( IF ( [전년 대비 증감률] < 0, "@neg", "@pos" ), "#", "%23" ) VAR _stroke = SUBSTITUTE ( "@ink3", "#", "%23" ) RETURN IF ( COUNTROWS ( _t ) > 1, "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='24' viewBox='0 0 100 24'><polyline fill='none' stroke='" & _stroke & "' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round' points='" & _pts & "'/><circle cx='97' cy='" & FORMAT ( 21 - ( _end - _lo ) * 18 / _rng, "0.0", "en-US" ) & "' r='2.4' fill='" & _dot & "'/></svg>" )

AOV YoY %.expr: VAR prev = DIVIDE ( [전년 매출], [Orders PY] ) RETURN IF ( prev > 0, DIVIDE ( [객단가] - prev, prev ) )

Margin YoY pp.expr: VAR ly = DIVIDE ( [전년 이익], [전년 매출] ) RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( ly ), [이익률] - ly )

Orders YoY %.expr: VAR prev = [Orders PY] RETURN IF ( prev > 0, DIVIDE ( [주문건수] - prev, prev ) )
